did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. Rahim Traders (a wholesale buyer) opened the order page, found "Order from a list", and uploaded a small CSV of three lines (Napa 500mg 3 box, Seclo 20mg 2 box, and a made-up name) then pressed "Add to my order".

checks.text: The wholesale order page has "Order from a list": a CSV with name, quantity, unit on each line, with "Download an example"
The matching line (Seclo 20 mg, 2 boxes) went into the order to read through: "1 lines added to your order"
Lines that do not match are listed with the reason and never guessed at: "Line 4 ... We could not find this product" and, for Napa, "Several products have this name. Add the strength"

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The earlier note that no bulk upload was found was wrong: the control sits lower on the page.
Small wording point: the Napa line already carried the strength, but several Napa 500 mg products exist, so the message "Add the strength" does not tell the buyer what else to add.
